context_for_next_testing_agent: Kirmes module fully tested. Key flows: Admin creates event (entwurf) -> releases event (freigegeben) -> Public schausteller registers/logs in -> selects event -> fills signup form -> submits. Signups visible in admin event detail page. Fixed: SchaustellerAnmeldungPage.jsx line 87 was using api.get() for login, changed to api.post() to match backend POST endpoint.
